2023_054_vs_elementary.paragraph: Quotation 0200148910, Revision 5, from VS America, Inc. to Troy School District for classroom furniture purchased through the Omnia Partners Region 4 ESC cooperative contract, Contract # R191818. Quoted 02/23/2023 and revised 03/17/2023 under the customer reference GLFS/TMP-Troy SD Elementary Pilot, it prices furnishings for 24 numbered classroom sections at Schroeder, Barnard, Morse, Troy Union, Wattles, Bemis, Hamilton, Costello, Leonard, Hills, Martell and Wass elementary schools. The quote carries a subtotal of $258,730.05, installation of $24,580.00 and a total of $283,310.05, on Net 30 days payment terms.

Overview
Quotation number 0200148910, Revision 5, issued by VS America, Inc. of 1940 Abbott Street, Suite 501, Charlotte, NC 28203 to Troy School District. Date quoted 02/23/2023; revision date 03/17/2023. Customer reference: GLFS/TMP-Troy SD Elementary Pilot. Contract: Omnia Partners Region 4 ESC, Contract # R191818. Inside sales contact Matthew Hillman, 704-378-6500; territory manager Christine Debrot; contact emails m.hillman@vsamerica.com and c.debrot@vsamerica.com. The address block also shows 4400 Livernois, Troy MI 48098, United States. The quote runs 51 pages and is dated 03/17/2023 in the page footers.

Commercial terms
- Pricing is presented in Omnia Partners Region 4 ESC Contract NET values based on the stated models, colors, finishes and quantities; any alterations are subject to updated pricing.
- Pricing is valid for 30 days for projects delivering within 9 months of the receipt of a complete PO, barring the announcement of a formal price increase. Orders with delivery requirements outside of 9 months must be requoted.
- Factory-direct orders qualify for free shipping if the total net amount is over $50,000 USD. Freight charges apply to orders fulfilled from the VS America Stock / Quickship Program.
- Installation is not included in unit pricing.
- Payment terms: Net 30 days. POs to be sent to orders@vsamerica.com.
- Every line item is discounted 22.40000 percent off list.

What is being bought
Each classroom section is assembled from lettered kits (Kit 1A through Kit 7D) drawn from the VS product lines: student tables (Shift+ Base freeform concave 01441 and convex 01440, Tano 01490, LiteTable-ST 21090 and 21093, EcoTable-R 23003 and 23064, Puzzle free-form 01470, FlipTable-RU 22106, Shift+ Base half-round group table 01442), height-adjustable RondoLift-KF stand-at tables 02825, seating (Solo stool 03826, Hokki active stool 03825, Rondo stool 03823, LuPoStool 03429 and LuPoStool with back rest 03428, Shift+ Landscape seat modules 09325, 09328 and 09329), mobile storage (Shift+ Landscape low cabinets 45318, 45293, 45325 and 45327, HomeBox 04006, Gugl 01486), and soft/collaborative elements (Leaf tent elements 09448, Leaf tent pole 09449, Leaf magnetic fixings 09444, Leaf storage bags 09450, Shift+ Landscape padded mats 09446 and 09447, Magnetic vinyl A2 45274).

Standard finishes
Metal color 059 arctic; laminate 027 natural beech; writeable white laminate 443 on group tables; edge banding 2.5mm plastic and 019-uniblack on special items; seat module covers S40 Stamskin Top 7445 grey to CAL TB 117-2013; Leaf tent covers S76/77 Mirage E 6366 turquoise, E 6464 green and E 6133 orange; packaging with export protection throughout.

Contract: Omnia Partners Region 4 ESC, Contract # R191818. Inside Sales Contact: Matthew Hillman, 704-378-6500. Territory Manager: Christine Debrot. Correspondence addresses given are m.hillman@vsamerica.com and c.debrot@vsamerica.com. The header block lists 704-378-6500 and 4400 Livernois, Troy MI 48098, United States, while the VS America corporate address is 1940 Abbott Street, Suite 501, Charlotte, NC 28203. Page footers read (0200148910) Page 51 / 51 dated 03/17/2023 with the web address http://vsamerica.com/.

Terms and conditions. Pricing is presented in Omnia Partners Region 4 ESC Contract NET values based on the stated models, colors, finishes and quantities, and any alterations are subject to updated pricing. Pricing is valid for 30 days for projects delivering within 9 months of the receipt of a complete PO; orders with delivery requirements outside of 9 months must be requoted. The validity note is qualified by barring the announcement of a formal price increase. Factory-direct orders qualify for free shipping if the total net amount is over $50,000 USD; freight charges apply for any orders fulfilled from the VS America Stock / Quickship Program, with exclusions and restrictions set out in the Customer Freight Terms document, Omnia Region 4 Freight Terms. Selected section detail.

Schroeder ES - Classroom 18 (Section 1) covers Kit 1C LiteTable-ST 21090 lightweight construction table, stackable, circular steel tube frame, table weight 13.5 kg, 76cm size blue, width 70.0 cm and depth 55.0 cm, quantity 12 at unit list $355.00 and unit net $275.48 for $3,305.76; Kit 4D Shift+ Base freeform group table 01442, half-round, 5-leg frame, table top WxD 160x46/78cm with edge in 019-uniblack, quantity 1 at list $1170.00 and net $907.92; Kit 4D Solo stool 03826 with 4 footrests at different heights, quantity 4 at list $160.00 and net $124.16 for $496.64; Kit 6B Shift+ Landscape seat module 09329, 60 degree round element, W/D 109.9x52.8cm, radius 57.2/110cm, 46cm size blue, quantity 2 at list $1475.00 and net $1,144.60 for $2,289.20; Kit 7B Shift+ Landscape low cabinet with shelves 45293, 60 degree round element with middle partition, W/H/D 152.6x110.2x42.5cm, radius 111/153.5cm, quantity 2 at list $2105.00 and net $1,633.48 for $3,266.96; and Magnetic vinyl 45274, writeable, A2, quantity 1 at list $195.00 and net $151.32.

Barnard ES - Classroom 6 (Section 2) is the simplest room, consisting only of Kit 1A Tano 01490 asymmetrical multipurpose table, stackable, width 70cm, 64cm size red, with plastic box 7.5cm high translucent, quantity 20 at list $470.00 and net $364.72 for $7,294.40, plus Kit 2A EcoTable-R 23003 four-legged round tube frame, width 130.0 cm and depth 50.0 cm, quantity 4 at list $685.00 and net $531.56 for $2,126.24.

Morse ES - Classroom 24 (Section 3) runs items 3.1 through 3.11 and includes Shift+ Base freeform student tables 01441 concave and 01440 convex at list $425.00 and net $329.80 each, LiteTable-ST 21090 at $275.48 net for $2,203.84, EcoTable-R 23003 at $531.56 net, the 01442 group table at $907.92, Hokki active stools 03825 in light blue and light green at list $125.00 and net $97.00, a HomeBox left 04006 pull-out storage unit with unified locking 18001 and metal bow handle, dimensions EM1 width 500, EM2 height 720, EM3 depth 800, at list $1658.00 and net $1,286.61, a 09329 seat module pair at $989.40 net for $1,978.80, and a Kit 7C Shift+ Landscape low cabinet with shelves 45318, width 105.5 cm, height 110.2 cm, depth 42.5 cm, at list $1480.00 and net $1,148.48.

Wattles ES - Classroom 21 (Section 5) includes two Kit 7A Shift+ Landscape low cabinets 45325 with 2 intermediate partitions: one configured with 7.5cm and 15cm translucent plastic boxes at list $2220.00 and net $1,722.72, and one with three rows of 15cm boxes at list $2130.00 and net $1,652.88. It also carries Rondo stools 03823, steel, stackable, multiplex seat, diameter 35cm, at list $135.00 and net $104.76, and Hokki stools at the 31cm size violet height in dark red and dark-grey at list $115.00 and net $89.24.

Hamilton ES - Classroom 2 (Section 7) is built around Kit 6H, the Leaf tent grouping: Leaf-tent elements 09448 in S76/77 Mirage E 6366 turquoise, E 6464 green and E 6133 orange, each quantity 2 at list $295.00 and net $228.92 for $457.84 per color; Leaf-tent pole 09449 at list $595.00 and net $461.72; Gugl 01486 accompanying unit with storage space function and removable cover, diameter 63 cm and height 39.8 cm, at list $1020.00 and net $791.52; Leaf-magnetic fixings 09444 at list $40.00 and net $31.04 for $186.24; Leaf-storage bags 09450 at list $100.00 and net $77.60 for $465.60; and Shift+ Landscape padded mats 09447, 60 degree, WxHxD 106.2x86.9 cm, radius 24/110.1cm, at list $555.00 and net $430.68 for $2,584.08. The room also includes a RondoLift-KF 02825 sitting/stand-at table with gas-lift height adjustment from 71-115cm, diameter 100.0 cm, at list $1895.00 and net $1,470.52.

Morse ES - Classroom 1 (Section 9) repeats the Leaf tent package and adds Kit 7D Shift+ Landscape low cabinet 45327 with 2 intermediate partitions and 3 doors, unified locking 18001, quantity 2 at list $2085.00 and net $1,617.96 for $3,235.92.

Troy Union - Classroom 28 (Section 14) is the widest assortment, items 14.1 through 14.15, including Kit 4A Puzzle free-form table 01470 with amoeba-shaped table top 165x114cm, mobile on castors, quantity 2 at list $958.00 and net $743.41 for $1,486.82; LuPoStool 03429 at list $175.00 and net $135.80; and LuPoStool with back rest 03428 at 61cm seat height, list $260.00 and net $201.76.

Martell ES - Classroom 13 (Section 18) includes four 09329 seat modules at 46cm size blue, list $1475.00 and net $1,144.60 for $4,578.40, plus a Kit 6I Leaf grouping with rectangular Shift+ Landscape padded mats 09446, WxHxD 105x8x85 cm, at net $430.68 for $861.36.

Wass ES - Classroom 25 (Section 21) is the highest-value room and includes ten EcoTable-R 23003 tables at list $555.00 and net $430.68 for $4,306.80, and two 45325 cabinets with three rows of 15cm boxes at net $1,652.88 for $3,305.76.

Wattles ES - Classroom 14 (Section 24) closes the quote with LiteTable-ST 21090 tables at $1,101.92, EcoTable-R 23003 with plastic box at list $675.00 and net $523.80 for $2,095.20, a RondoLift-KF 02825 at $1,470.52, Solo stools at $496.64, two Hokki stools at $89.24 each, a 45325 cabinet at $1,757.64, and Magnetic vinyl at $151.32.

Finishes and options recur throughout: metal color 059 arctic; top 055 chipboard laminated at 19mm thickness or 001 chipboard decor at 25mm; color laminate 027 natural beech laminate; 443 white writeable laminate on group and flip tables; table top edges of 2.5mm plastic with 019-uniblack on special items; seat module covers 989 S40 Stamskin Top 7445 grey in version 088 CAL TB 117-2013; base type 029 mobile with special castors d= 10cm; finished backs 022 perforated metal in arctic; equipment 074 with magnet for linking; lock 001 unified locking 18001 with 022 metal bow handle, Cr-plated; and packaging 002 with export protection on every line.
